cx.title: Components
cx.intro: Every component of the Zeyn framework, running live. Open one to see its examples, the code that builds them and its API.
cx.api_note: Public methods, read from the framework source when this site was built. The first line of each doc comment is shown; docs.rs has the rest.

summary.stack: Nodes one under the other with a gap.
summary.row: Columns side by side that stack on narrow screens.
summary.card: A bordered box with an optional title.
summary.panel: A titled section that can collapse.
summary.tabs: Panels behind a tab list, loaded the first time they open.
summary.split: Two panes with a handle that resizes them.
summary.auto_grid: As many columns as fit the width.
summary.heading: Section headings from h2 to h6.
summary.paragraph: A paragraph of escaped text, normal or quiet.
summary.meta_line: Short facts on one line with a separator.
summary.badge: A short status label in a tone.
summary.avatar: A picture of a person or their initials.
summary.description_list: Label and value pairs of a record.
summary.timeline: Events in order, each with a tone.
summary.markdown: Safe Markdown rendered on the server.
summary.spoiler: Content hidden until the reader opens it.
summary.accordion: Sections that open and close under their titles.
summary.avatar_group: The people of one thing, with a count for the rest.
summary.quote: Quoted words with who said them and where.
summary.kbd: Keys to press, one or a combination.
summary.divider: A line between parts, with an optional label.
summary.stepper: Where a process stands, step by step.
summary.pagination: Links to the pages of a list.
summary.copy_button: Copies a text to the clipboard.
summary.progress_ring: Progress as a ring with the percent inside.
summary.heatmap: A number for each day as a calendar of shaded squares.
summary.funnel: Stages that narrow from the first to the last.
summary.activity_rings: Shares of several goals as rings inside one another.
summary.gantt: Tasks as bars over a span of days.
summary.org_chart: A hierarchy as boxes joined by lines.
summary.comparison_table: Plans side by side with a row for each feature.
summary.table: A small table of text the screen already holds.
summary.indicator: A count or a dot on the corner of another component.
summary.meter: A measurement within a range, colored by its thresholds.
summary.highlight: The words of a search marked in a text.
summary.toc: Links to the headings of the page.
summary.breadcrumb: The trail of links to the current page.
summary.prev_next: Links to the previous and the next item.
summary.alpha_index: A letter bar from the user's alphabet.
summary.menu_button: Drop down and split buttons with actions.
summary.external_link: A link that leaves the app safely.
summary.form: A form of a model, checked on the server.
summary.controls: Radio buttons, segmented buttons and switches.
summary.lookup: Pick a record from a search on the server.
summary.line_editor: Rows of a model inside a form, with totals.
summary.masked_inputs: Masked, decimal, percent and password inputs.
summary.action_button: A button that runs an action.
summary.data_grid: Rows of an action with paging, sorting and filters.
summary.card_grid: Rows of an action shown as cards.
summary.image_card: A card with an image, badges and progress.
summary.rail: A row of cards that scrolls sideways.
summary.list: Rows with an image, a title and meta text.
summary.topics: Filters and actions that refresh other parts of the screen in place.
summary.tree: Branches loaded from the server as they open.
summary.document_viewer: A paged report preview whose pages are fetched as they come into view.
summary.week_schedule: Seven day columns of rows from an action.
summary.image: A picture with required alt text and size.
summary.embed: A page of another site in a locked frame.
summary.alert: A message in a tinted box.
summary.empty_state: What a list shows when it has nothing.
summary.popover: A button that opens a small panel.
summary.busy: An overlay while a slow action runs.
summary.toast: A short notice after an action.
summary.chart: Bar, donut, combo and gauge charts.
summary.kpi: A number with its change and trend.
summary.app_header: A bar over the screens of the app shell, with a search box and links.
summary.theme_picker: The theme choice inside a screen, in step with the menu.
summary.icon: The icons of buttons, menus and tools.
summary.screen_header: The title row of a screen: a subtitle and the main actions.
summary.toolbox: A group of tool buttons, one selected.
summary.status_bar: A bar of short status texts.
summary.relative_time: A moment shown as "5 minutes ago" in the page language.
summary.share: Share a link, or copy it where sharing is missing.
summary.rating: A whole number from 1 to N shown as stars.
summary.chips: Link chips and filter chips over a screen param.
summary.hero: A large image section, with slides that move only when asked.
summary.reactions: Reaction buttons with counts stored by an action.
summary.link_button: A link to another page that looks like a button.
summary.clear_prefs: A button that removes the choices this browser keeps for the app.
summary.diff_view: The fields that changed in a record, old and new side by side or inline.
summary.code_editor: Editable SQL and expressions with highlighting, line numbers, completion and error markers.
summary.code_view: Read only code and JSON, highlighted, numbered and folded on the server.
summary.barcode: Code 128 barcodes and QR codes drawn as SVG on the server.
summary.inbox: Notifications by day with bulk mark read and archive, and the bell with the unread count.
summary.kanban: Cards in columns of a workflow, moved by drag, a menu or the keyboard.
summary.calendar: Events in a month, week or day in the user time zone, with event windows and slots.
summary.price: A price with a struck old price, the percent off and a unit price.
summary.range_slider: Two handles over one track for price and date ranges.
summary.quantity_stepper: Minus and plus buttons around a number whose stock the server checks.
summary.variant_picker: Color swatches and size chips that change the price, photo and stock in place.
summary.product_gallery: Product photos with thumbnails, zoom, swipe and a full screen view.
summary.facet_panel: Counted filters, a price range and chosen filter chips that refresh product cards in place.
summary.review_summary: The average rating, the number of reviews and a bar for each star from 5 to 1.
summary.countdown: The time left until a moment on the server's clock, with an end state.
summary.message_thread: Chat bubbles by sender and day, delivery states, a history that loads as it scrolls, streamed AI replies.
summary.composer: A growing message box with send keys, attachments, @ mentions and drafts per conversation.
summary.typing_indicator: Who else is typing in a conversation, over the realtime channel.
summary.story_ring: An avatar in a ring that says whether its stories are new.
summary.lightbox: Images and videos that open full screen, with captions, zoom and swipes.
summary.feed: An endless stream of posts that holds new ones behind a button.
summary.color_input: A hex color with a picker, the colors used last and a palette.
summary.length_input: A length stored in pixels and shown in a unit the user picks.
summary.property_inspector: Edits what an island selects, from a schema the island sends.

chart.side_by_side: Side by side, filling the width

data_grid.confirm_actions: Row and bulk actions that ask first
data_grid.numbers: Numbers grouped by locale, a plain year
data_grid.computed_million: A million computed rows, built a page at a time
data_grid.dynamic_columns: Columns that come with the rows: 10,000 rows of 30 columns

kpi.row_of_four: A row of four, equal heights

list.builder: Rows built with any node, with a separator
list.virtual_rows: Virtual scrolling with a fixed row height
list.repeat: One node per item of an in memory list

search_box.rich: Rows with an image and a link

topics.overview: Filter chips that drive a KPI, a chart and a grid
topics.select: A select that drives the same listeners
topics.date_range_and_search: A date range and a search box that drive a list
topics.refresh_after_an_action: An action that refreshes a node

document_viewer.plain: Twelve Letter pages without side panels

tree.draggable: Leaves that drag onto a drop target, or insert with a button or Control+Enter

typing.realtime: This catalog runs without the realtime channel, so the indicator stays empty and the composer sends no typing signals. In an app with App::realtime and the topic declared, the names of the others show here while they type.
